title: Harden residual verify quality policy
instructions:
Implement only the S4 residual deterministic verification-quality policy hardening found by source-of-truth review. Keep all code changes inside src/core/policy.ts and all test changes inside tests/policy.test.ts. Do not change setup timeout, worker runtime timeout, verify timeout, test discovery hygiene, CLI behavior, task templates, docs, lifecycle artifacts, dashboards, daemon/watch behavior, remote adapters, writerCap, hidden memory, or LLM semantic verification.

Policy direction:
- Prefer a repo-specific allowed verification family over broad shell parsing or an ever-growing deny-list.
- Treat real repository verification as exact broad commands such as bun test and bun run typecheck, or focused test commands such as bun test tests/<name>.test.ts that are related to the task target files.
- Keep docs-only/minimal-change writer tasks allowed to use git diff --check when they do not trigger core-module, tdd-first, or lifecycle-sensitive verification requirements.
- Do not count grep, test -f, test -e, test -s, echo, pwd, ls, git status, true, false, sleep, watch/dev/server commands, or their simple shell-wrapped equivalents as satisfying verification quality.
- Shell wrappers must not become a bypass. Block or unwrap deterministically enough to reject simple no-op/watch/dev wrappers including bash -lc true, /bin/bash -lc true, bash -l -c true, env bash -lc true, sh -lc "echo ok", and zsh -lc "sleep 999". Keep this small; do not build a general shell parser.
- Writer tasks with taskFamily core-module or workMode tdd-first must include a real test runner or typecheck command from the allowed repository verification family.
- Focused test commands used to satisfy core-module or tdd-first verification must be related to targetFiles. For this repository, src/core/<name>.ts should be satisfied by bun test tests/<name>.test.ts, while broad bun test or bun run typecheck may satisfy shared or broad verification. Do not accept bun test tests/unrelated.test.ts for targetFiles such as src/core/worker-result.ts.
- Writer tasks with riskClass lifecycle-sensitive must include broad verification. Focused tests alone must not satisfy lifecycle-sensitive broad verification.
- Preserve existing writer/non-writer, allowNoop/noopRationale, targetFiles, forbiddenChanges, verifyCommands-required, and bundled profile policy behavior.

Required tests:
- A docs-only/minimal-change writer task with verifyCommands ["/bin/bash -lc true"] is blocked.
- A docs-only/minimal-change writer task with verifyCommands ["env bash -lc true"] is blocked.
- A docs-only/minimal-change writer task with verifyCommands ["bash -l -c true"] is blocked.
- A writer task with shell-wrapped simple output or long-running/dev/watch verify commands such as sh -lc "echo ok" and zsh -lc "sleep 999" is blocked.
- A core-module or tdd-first writer task with only grep, test -f, git diff --check, or unrelated focused bun test verification is blocked.
- A core-module writer task targeting src/core/worker-result.ts with verifyCommands ["bun test tests/unrelated.test.ts"] is blocked.
- A core-module writer task targeting src/core/policy.ts with verifyCommands ["bun test tests/policy.test.ts"] remains accepted.
- A routine core-module or tdd-first writer task with broad bun test or bun run typecheck remains accepted.
- A lifecycle-sensitive writer task with only a focused bun test remains blocked, while one with bun test or bun run typecheck remains accepted.
- A docs-only/minimal-change writer task with git diff --check remains accepted when it does not trigger core-module, tdd-first, or lifecycle-sensitive requirements.
- Non-writer report task rules remain unchanged.

End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
